events.title: Steam Deck Compatibility
events.summary: Hey everyone,The game is playable on Steam Deck, but you might encounter some issues with the font and font size.Starport Merchants is a text-heavy game and some changes had to be made to make reading easier on smaller displays. When you launch the game on Steam Deck, the font will be automatically adjusted to a pixel font and the size of the text will scale to accommodate the screen size. As a result, you might notice that some lines of text will be split up in 2 lines to prevent text overflow

events.summary: Hi there,Time for some new features!Freight DepotFor the space truckers out there, you can now start a Freight Depot contract on Bron. A Freight Depot contract will require you to fill up a bulk order for a single commodity. You'll need to spend several weeks on it, but the reward is very much worth it.Tourism CharterAnd also something new for the players who enjoy transporting passengers around. events.title: Join the Playtest!
events.summary: Hi everyone!You can now join the Starport Merchants Playtest. This playtest opens up the first 150 weeks of the game so you can get a better taste of the gameplay beyond the demo.Visit the Steam page to join!The goal is to gather as much feedback as possible, so don't forget to use the in-game feedback button or even better, join us on Discord:https://discord.gg/XKQrbwdwuC

events.summary: Calling all traders for Planetary Defense!Caelux needs you! Only trusted merchants can apply for Planetary Defense.This new income source can be found on the Administrative Center. Earn money for every destroyed ship.Happy hunting!
